svg.title: The runs of a replaced commit
svg.desc: A new commit on a pull request starts the job signed commits, and a merge or an update of a branch starts the branch bot, both of which run anyway. Each takes the runs that wait or run, then the heads of the open pull requests. The head of an open pull request, a run of main, a release, a workflow that is no check, a second attempt and a run younger than 20 seconds stay. A second list of GitHub looks at the commit of each other run, and when it agrees, the bot cancels the run, which gives its runner back. After the checks, no job starts for it, as the event names the heads of the open pull requests.
